Definition: from G1537 and G2285; utterly astounded:--greatly wondering.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, ékthambos is the word for greatly wondering. In Acts 3:11, the text says "greatly wondering."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, ékthambos means greatly wondering, nothing more and nothing less.
